# Attribution and scope

Prepared for eumemic with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; Apache-2.0.
This package contributes a source-bound operational transfer of the public
PR327 p10 complex supplier: parameterized complete scalar/frame splices,
recomputed p10 finite invoice and precision guards, generic B2 source binding,
and a mandatory full public-source replay before admission. It claims no κ.

DreamingOfClouds (Anthropic Claude assistance) authored PR327's p10 modules,
public producer pipeline and certificates; its complete NOTICE is preserved
under `vendor/pr327/NOTICE`. The p10 query modules and certificate are used
byte for byte. The unused experimental modules derived in this chat are not
inputs to this package. All historical contributors, including icekylinx,
Avi Eisenberg/ikeboy, chafreaky/Chafik Boukhalfa, Jacob Sussman, eumemic,
DaysSky, hcg890 and SovereignSteak, retain the detailed attributions shipped
by PR327 and by the unmodified PR315 reference package.

The reference label/scalar/splice/guard code comes from PR315 through the
frozen neutral-retiming package under `vendor/neutral`; its original notices,
source pins and manifest remain unchanged. This package does not use that
package's retimed p11 candidate. Every actual code adaptation for p10 is
logged in DERIVATION.json and reconstructed from the source bytes at runtime.
Jacob Sussman's gx and gxcore remain byte-identical and his generic B2 Lean
source is separately pinned at f010392c923279e3dd59ef3aa5fedad23affc5fd.
Credits do not imply endorsement or independent review. No exclusive priority,
new Lean build, unconditional multiplication theorem or runtime claim is made.
